question: What share of the protein in alternative-protein foods made in Vietnam (textured soy, chay, plant milks, blends) comes from domestic inputs, by route?
why_it_matters: Decides whether 'made in Vietnam' protein reduces import dependence or only moves it; the study's 11,000 to 17,000 t made in Vietnam (D-BENCH 2035) does not say
cheapest_way_to_close: Declaration-level customs data for HS 1208.10, 2304 (food grade), 3504, 2106.10 and 1109 by importer, plus calls to three textured-soy and chay makers on flour and protein origin
owner_org_to_ask: General Department of Customs; chay and textured-soy makers

question: What share of the fish eaten in Vietnam comes from capture, aquaculture and imports?
why_it_matters: If capture supplies most fish eaten at home, the policy cut of about 27% by 2030 is the largest change in protein-food supply in the study's horizon
cheapest_way_to_close: FAO FishStat production and trade plus the food balance sheet; MAE fisheries statistics on domestic use of capture landings
owner_org_to_ask: MAE Department of Fisheries and Fisheries Surveillance; FAO

question: Has MAE reviewed Resolution 34/NQ-CP at mid-term, and is a successor (food security after 2030) being drafted with any import-dependence, feed or protein indicator?
why_it_matters: A successor is the natural home for a protein-security indicator; Resolution 34 has none
cheapest_way_to_close: Targeted search of mae.gov.vn and vanban.chinhphu.vn; ask MAE planning department
owner_org_to_ask: MAE Department of Planning and Finance

question: Which raw materials and volumes does MAE's 2026 task 'reduce import dependence by developing domestic raw-material areas' cover (soybean, maize, cassava, other)?
why_it_matters: If it names protein crops or fermentation feedstocks with volumes, it is the first measurable official import-dependence target for protein inputs
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask MAE's Department of Livestock Production and Animal Health for the implementing plan
owner_org_to_ask: MAE Department of Livestock Production and Animal Health

question: What is the next national marine stock assessment (after 2016 to 2020), and did the standing stock keep falling?
why_it_matters: Tests whether wild fish, a quarter of animal protein supply, is still being depleted under the capture cut
cheapest_way_to_close: Research Institute for Marine Fisheries reports; NSO fisheries releases

question: How many hours of power outage a year do rural livestock farms and industrial-park fermentation plants face in southern and northern Vietnam?
why_it_matters: Tests whether domestic fermentation is less or more exposed than closed animal houses to heat and power failure
cheapest_way_to_close: EVN reliability indices (SAIDI) by province and feeder type

question: Has China imposed or considered export licensing or controls on soy protein isolate, textured protein, wheat gluten or pea protein?
why_it_matters: China supplies about 84% of Vietnam's imported food plant-protein ingredient tonnage; an export control would be a direct food-protein supply shock
cheapest_way_to_close: Check China's Ministry of Commerce and General Administration of Customs export-control lists and announcements, 2020 to 2026

question: Is there an official monthly pork price series behind the CPI pork sub-index, and can NSO supply it for 2019 to 2026?
why_it_matters: Annual pork CPI changes are published in NSO price releases (2020: +57.23%; 2022: minus 10.68%); a monthly series would date shocks precisely
cheapest_way_to_close: Request the pork sub-index from NSO; read NSO monthly price releases
